-- Proto_p4
SL_Ctx.Proto_p4 = function(y, F, f, l, w, T, v) if w <= 12 then
	local J = y [5](v, F)
	return not(J < 128) and 28 or 39, f, J, l
elseif w <= 13 then
		local w = y [5](v, 1 + F)
		return not(w < 128) and 7 or 34, w, T, l
	else
		local l = y [5](v, F + 2)
		return not(128 > l) and 8 or 3, f, T, l
	end
end

-- Proto__
SL_Ctx.Proto__ = function(y, F, f, l, w, T, v, J, t, h, d) if F <= 16 then
	if F <= 15 then
	local M = y [5](t, f)
	return notnot(128 <= M) and 27 or 62, J, f, w, M, h, v
else
		return 52, J, f + 1, w, d, h, v
	end
elseif F <= 17 then
		return 31, J, f + 1, w, d, h, v
	elseif F <= 18 then
		local F = y [5](t, f + 3)
		local t, M, n, Z = 2097152 * (w - 128), (T - 128) * 128, l - 128, 16384 * (F % 128)
		local l = (F - F % 128) * 2097152 + (M + Z) + (t + n)
		return 52, J, 4 + f, l, d, h, v
	else
		local F = h - 68808
		local l, T, v = y [77](F), y [77](F), 1 + 0
		local y = 1 - v
		return 85, {v, F + 0, y, J, nil}, f, w, d, l, T
	end
end

end

	else

		local n, Z, G, p = (t * M + J) % 256, y.G, d * 256, 65536 * M
		Z [f] = n * 16777216 + (G + l + p)

	end
end

-- Proto_x4
SL_Ctx.Proto_x4 = function(y, F, f, l, w, T, v, J, t, h, d) if f <= 18 then
	local M, n, Z = h [4], h [1], h [5]
	local G, p = M + n, n <= 0
	M, n = G >= Z, G <= Z
	Z = p and M or notp and n
	h [4] = G
	if Z then
	return 1, l, G, J
else
		return 21, l, w, J
	end
elseif f <= 19 then
		local f, h = 128 * (w - 128), v - 128
		local v = 16384 * d + (h + f)
		return 40, 3 + l, v, J
	else
		local f, v, h, d = y [5](T, 3 + l), (J - 128) * 2097152, (F - 128) * 128, t - 128
		local y = f % 128 * 16384 + (f - f % 128) * 2097152 + (d + (h + v))
		return 24, 4 + l, w, y
	end
end
